title: 场景与人物关系题
goal: 结合场景词、双方行为与职责判断地点和人物关系。

points.label: 依据行为与场景词判断地点
依据双方职责与称呼判断关系

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 场景与人物关系的教学内容及课程小测规格

body.p: 地点题看两人在做什么、用了哪些场所用语。关系题看双方各做什么事、怎样称呼对方。

body.box:
A: May I return these books?
B: Yes. I can also renew the one you still need.

body.p: return books 和 renew 都与借书有关，地点是图书馆。办理续借的是馆员，另一方是借书的人。

steps.d: 地点题问在哪里，关系题问两人是什么身份。Where 问地点，How are the speakers related 问关系。
至少找到两处词句再判断。return books 和 renew 都指向借书。
分清谁请求服务、谁提供服务。说 make an appointment 的是预约者，说 check the schedule 的是接待人员。
选项中的关系要有称呼或职责作依据。一方交作业、另一方收下，是师生关系。

cards.title: 场景与身份线索
rows: 预约
A: I'd like an appointment with the dentist. B: The dentist has an opening on Tuesday.
牙科诊所；预约者与接待人员。
结账
A: Could I have the bill for our meal? B: Certainly. You can pay at the counter.
餐馆；用餐者与服务人员。
借阅
A: Can I borrow these books? B: Yes, your library card is all I need.
图书馆；借书者与馆员。
交作业
A: Professor, may I hand in my essay now? B: Yes, put it on my desk before class.
课堂或教师办公室；学生与教师。

cards.title: 相近关系辨析
rows: book a table / I'll reserve it
顾客与餐馆工作人员
一方订位，另一方办理。
our shift / I'll cover your shift
同事
两人在同一处工作，互相代班。
Professor / hand in my essay
学生与教师
称呼是 Professor，一方交作业。
my essay / shall we study together
一起学习的人
两人一起学习，没有一方在教，不是师生。

body.box:
A: Could I book a table for Saturday evening?
B: Certainly. How many people will be dining?
A: Four, please.

How are the speakers most likely related?
1. Two restaurant customers.
2. A diner and a restaurant worker.
3. Two restaurant workers.
4. Two friends planning a dinner.

body.p: 一方要 book a table，另一方问几位用餐，是在办理预订。双方是顾客和餐馆工作人员，即第二项。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 只看物品
book → bookshop
borrow 和 library card 都指向图书馆。
混淆双方
book a table / reserve it → two diners
说 reserve it 的一方在办理预订，是工作人员。
推断过度
study together → teacher and student
两人一起学习，没有一方在教。
混淆地点
bill for our meal → library
meal 和 bill 都指向餐馆。

lines.text: I'd like to borrow these two novels. My library card is in my bag, and I'll return them before the end of the month.
Thank you. I'll check them out for you now.

items.stem: Where are the speakers most likely?
options: At a desk in the library
items.why: borrow these two novels 和 library card 都指向图书馆，另一方说 I'll check them out，是在办理借书，即第二项。

lines.text: Professor Li, I finished my assignment on local rivers. May I leave it on your desk before the geography lesson starts?
Yes, and I'll return your previous assignment after class.

items.stem: How are the speakers most likely related?
items.why: 称呼是 Professor Li，一方交作业，另一方课后发还上次的作业。两人是学生和老师，即第四项。

lines.text: Could I see the menu again? I'd like some soup before the main course, and my friend is ready to order as well.
Of course. I'll bring your soup first.

items.stem: Where are the speakers most likely?
items.why: menu、order 和 I'll bring your soup 都指向餐馆，一方点菜，另一方上菜，即第一项。

lines.text: Can you cover my shift at the reception desk on Friday? I covered yours last week, and I need to attend a course this time.
Yes, I'll take your shift on Friday.

items.stem: How are the speakers most likely related?
options: A course trainer and a trainee
items.why: cover my shift 和 I covered yours 说明两人在接待处互相代班，是同事，即第三项。

lines.text: Can I renew this book for another week? I'm still reading it for my project, and my library card is right here.
Certainly. I'll update the due date for you now.

items.stem: Where are the speakers most likely?
options: At a desk in the library
items.why: renew this book 和 library card 都指向图书馆，另一方在更改还书日期，即第一项。

lines.text: I'd like an appointment with Dr Bell to have my teeth checked. Is there a time available on Thursday afternoon?
Yes, the dentist can see you at two. I'll put your name in the schedule.

items.stem: How are the speakers most likely related?
items.why: 一方预约检查牙齿，另一方把名字记进日程。这一方说 the dentist can see you，所以不是牙医，是接待人员，即第二项。

lines.text: Could we have the bill for our meal, please? My friend and I need to leave soon to catch the bus.
Certainly. I'll bring the bill, and you can pay at your table.

items.stem: Where are the speakers most likely?
options: At a bus stop after a meal
items.why: bill for our meal 和 pay at your table 都指向餐馆，即第三项。bus 是两人饭后要赶的车。

lines.text: Ms Ross, may I submit my science report after the lesson? I need to attach the final chart before I give it to you.
Yes, Sam. I'll collect the reports from the class after lunch.

items.stem: How are the speakers most likely related?
options: Two students in a science class
items.why: Sam 称对方 Ms Ross，要交科学报告；Ms Ross 午饭后向全班收报告。两人是学生和老师，即第四项。

lines.text: Would you check whether we have a free room for tonight? A guest wants to stay for two nights near the station.
I'll look at our hotel bookings. We have one room available tonight.

items.stem: Where are the speakers most likely working?
items.why: A guest wants to stay 和 our hotel bookings 说明两人在酒店接待处工作，即第一项。station 只说明酒店的位置。

lines.text: Could you cover my shift at the ticket desk on Monday? I need to attend a training course, and I can take your shift on Friday.
That works. I'll take Monday's shift.

items.stem: How are the speakers most likely related?
options: A customer and a ticket seller
A teacher and a course student
items.why: 两人互换售票台的 shift，是一起工作的同事，即第二项。
